If the biquad depended on the clock it would equally depend on the microphone, the ADC, and the DAW — that is a supply chain, not a dependency.

payload.body: A category is a formal structure C = (Ob, Mor, (·)∘(·), (id_A)_(A∈Ob)): a collection of objects Ob, a collection of morphisms Mor between them, a composition operation assigning g∘f to each composable pair f: A→B, g: B→C, and an identity morphism id_A for each object A. Parameters: (1) the object and morphism collections, (2) the composition law on hom-sets, (3) the identity family; the axioms are associativity, (h∘g)∘f = h∘(g∘f), and the identity laws, id_C∘g = g = g∘id_B. Special cases include the empty category (all axioms vacuously satisfied), Set (objects are sets, morphisms are functions), Grp (groups and homomorphisms), and Top (spaces and continuous maps); restricting to the endomorphisms of a single object yields a monoid. It is a human-made formal object — a frame built to make structure-preserving maps comparable across algebra, topology, and logic — not a description of any natural collection. It persists as the definition in the canonical texts of category theory — Eilenberg and Mac Lane (1945), Mac Lane's Categories for the Working Mathematician, Awodey's Category Theory — cited and instantiated in every category-theoretic construction that names it. payload.body: An envelope follower is a circuit or algorithm that tracks the slowly varying amplitude of an input signal — its envelope — and outputs that amplitude as a separate, usable control signal without altering the input. Parameters: (1) detection — conversion of instantaneous signal level into a unipolar level (precision rectification, squaring, or magnitude computation); (2) time constants — attack (rise) and release (fall) smoothing that decide which level variations are tracked and which are averaged out; (3) output form — a voltage, digital value, or control signal with a defined gain relation to the measured level. The follower is a derivation stage: it produces a second signal about the first. Persistence mechanism: realized as an analog block (precision rectifier followed by RC low-pass smoothing) and a digital block (one-pole smoothing on rectified magnitude), standardized as the level-detection primitive in every automatic gain control, compressor, limiter, sidechain processor, and peak meter; the pattern persists through circuit-design textbooks and DSP code libraries that reproduce the rectify–smooth structure across generations of hardware and software. [formal: secutor | substrate: matter | horizon: generations | explicit: yes | epoch: 0.01]

payload.body: Makeup gain is the gain stage placed after a dynamic-range compression (or any gain-reduction) process that raises the overall signal level back to the intended output level, compensating for the reduction the compression applied. Parameters: (1) position — downstream of the gain-reduction stage in the signal chain, acting on the already-compressed signal; (2) amount — a fixed setting, or an automatic value tracking the compressor's average gain reduction (automatic makeup); (3) magnitude — expressed in decibels, typically set equal to the compressor's average reduction to restore perceived loudness. Makeup gain is a restoration stage: it applies amplification without threshold or ratio behavior and does not itself compress. Persistence mechanism: a universal design convention of dynamic processors — the makeup stage appears in every hardware compressor (its dedicated gain control) and every digital compressor plugin, persisting through studio-engineering practice, processor design documentation, and the standardization of the threshold–ratio–attack–release–makeup parameter set. [formal: compensatio | substrate: matter | horizon: generations | explicit: yes | epoch: 0.02]

Law 8b removal test fails; Law 2b/8b generic-field appeals file nothing.

'Needs the infrastructure providing gain adjustment' is backwards: the stage itself performs the adjustment. Law 8b removal test fails; the generic appeal to the parent discipline files nothing.

The note pins the sense to digital realization only, invoking samples as the data unit. That is a specific implementation sense, not the sense carved by the accepted definition, which includes analog operation. Under Law 11d judges must judge the pinned sense, and the pinned sense is not the sense the entry carries. The dependency is therefore not constitutive for the entry as defined; it is a contingent implementation detail. STRIKE.

Makeup gain is a gain STAGE: a component that applies amplification to restore signal level after compression. Its entire mechanism is gain manipulation — it adjusts the gain value (in dB) to bring level back up. The present-tense removal test passes: remove gain (the measure of amplification factor, the parameter it adjusts) and makeup gain has no mechanism to operate — it cannot amplify or restore level without the amplification-ratio it manipulates. This is consistent with the accepted precedent in the same family: compressor→gain, upward-expansion→gain, distortion→gain, saturator→gain are all ACCEPTED DEPENDS_ON edges on the identical mechanism. Direction: makeup-gain (dependent) → gain (operational mechanism object / parameter), per Law 8b removal test. Not identity (makeup gain is a specific application of the gain mechanism, not identical to the general measure) and not purpose (its function IS to apply gain, not merely to serve it).

Dynamic-range-processing is the family (compression, limiting, expansion, gating) whose accepted definition states it modifies dynamic range "by applying variable gain as a function of level" — gain is the family's defining mechanism, not an incidental property. The removal test passes: remove gain and the family has no mechanism — compressors cannot reduce gain, expanders cannot increase it, limiters cannot clamp peak gain, gates cannot open on level. This is a universal operational dependency, not a digital-only or representation-level one: analog VCAs and digital variable-gain stages both use gain, so it holds across every realization. Consistent with the ACCEPTED "compression→gain" and "compressor→gain" edges, which are members of this same family. Direction: DRC (dependent) → gain (operational mechanism / level-dependent gain law), per Law 8b.

By the transitive part-of chain — morphism is a part of Mor, and Mor is a part of the category — the morphism is a part of the category. The envelope follower's accepted definition names BOTH realizations: "an analog block (precision rectifier followed by RC low-pass smoothing) and a digital block (one-pole smoothing on rectified magnitude)." In the analog branch the input is a continuous signal — there are NO audio samples, yet the follower still tracks the envelope (precision rectify + RC smooth on the continuous voltage). The filer's argument is explicitly digital-only: "In digital realization the input signal is represented as a sequence of audio samples." But the Law 8b removal test must hold for the construct AS A PERSISTENT PATTERN across its realizations, and it does not: remove audio-sample and the analog envelope follower still operates. So the dependency on audio-sample is a property of one (digital) realization, not of the construct — a representation-level, digital-only gap. The true dependency is on SIGNAL (the input signal whose slowly-varying amplitude the follower tracks): remove signal and the follower has nothing to follow. This matches the established pattern for audio-processing constructs that persist in both analog and digital form — they depend on signal, not on the sample representation. STRIKE the sample edge; the correct dependency is on signal.

payload.body: External-representation is a human-made concept that maps the natural phenomenon of encoding information in media external to the mind — physical artifacts, symbols, or structures that carry informational content independently of any specific holder. Its parameters are: (1) the encoding medium — symbolic (text, notation, mathematics), spatial (maps, diagrams, layouts), material (artifacts, monuments), or temporal (rhythms, sequences, schedules); (2) the information type — propositional (facts, beliefs), procedural (instructions, methods), relational (spatial, hierarchical), or affective (emotional, aesthetic); (3) the persistence requirement — the duration the representation must survive independent of its author's mind. Persistence mechanism: sustained through material durability, social transmission practices, institutional maintenance, and encoding redundancy. Distinguished from cognitive-offloading by scope: external-representation carves the broader phenomenon of any mind-independent information encoding, while cognitive-offloading specifically addresses the strategy of reducing internal processing burden. [formal: representatio externa | substrate: mind | horizon: a lifetime | explicit: yes | epoch: 0.01]

The honest relations are already on the board: measurement is an INSTANCE_OF measurement (accepted), and audio-processing's definition already includes analysis/measurement as a processing type and objective. Contrast the accepted SERVES edges to audio-processing, whose servants are domain-specific constructs built for that purpose (biquad-filter, compressor, MFCC — "built and maintained specifically for speech and audio processing tasks"). payload.body: A spectrogram is a human-made data visualization that encodes the frequency content of a signal as it varies over time. Its parameters are: (1) frequency axis — the range and resolution of frequency bins (linear or logarithmic scale); (2) time axis — the temporal window and step size of the analysis; (3) amplitude encoding — magnitude representation (linear, decibel, or log scale); (4) window function — the overlap-add kernel (Hamming, Hanning, Blackman) applied per time window. Persistence mechanism: standardized in signal processing toolkits (MATLAB spectrogram, Python scipy.signal.spectrogram, librosa), documented in audio analysis literature, and rendered by audio analysis software for diagnostic and creative use. Distinguished from a frequency spectrum (which shows magnitude vs. frequency at a single moment) by its explicit time dimension, making it a time-frequency representation. [formal: spectrum spectrogram | substrate: mind | horizon: a moment | explicit: yes | epoch: 0.01]

payload.body: A colloquialism is a human-made linguistic construct: a word or phrase that belongs to informal, everyday speech rather than formal or technical registers. Its parameters are: (1) register — the degree of formality it signals (casual, familiar, vulgar); (2) lexical form — the specific word or phrase used (e.g., "kids" vs. "children," "gonna" vs. "going to"); (3) context dependency — the social situation or relationship between speaker and listener that makes it appropriate or inappropriate. Persistence mechanism: sustained by oral and written informal communication practices, transmitted through social interaction and community usage patterns, and codified in informal dictionaries and style guides that distinguish register levels. Distinguished from slang by its broader geographic and social spread; distinguished from jargon by its lack of domain-specific expertise requirement. [formal: sermones vulgi | substrate: behavior | horizon: a life | explicit: yes | epoch: 0.01]

payload.body: Binaural-rendering is a human-made audio processing technique that creates spatial sound perception through two-channel headphone playback by applying head-related transfer functions (HRTFs) to audio signals. Its parameters are: (1) spatial model — interaural time differences (ITD) for low-frequency localization, interaural level differences (ILD) for high-frequency localization, spectral filtering by pinnae for elevation cues; (2) HRTF source — measured individual HRTFs, generic KEMAR HRTFs, or parametric HRTF models; (3) signal path — convolution of dry audio with HRTF pairs (left/right for each source position), possibly including distance attenuation and room reverb tail. Persistence mechanism: implemented in binaural audio SDKs (Steam Audio, Oculus Spatializer, Apple Spatial Audio), game engines (Unity FMOD integration, Unreal Audio engine), DAW plugins (Waves Nx, Sennheiser AMBEO), and VR/AR audio pipelines. Distinguished from general stereo by its explicit use of HRTF-based spatial modeling rather than simple panning; distinguished from ambisonics by its two-channel output format versus full spherical encoding. [formal: binauralis-renderere | substrate: mind | horizon: a lifetime | explicit: yes | epoch: 0.01]

payload.name: head-related-transfer-function
payload.scope: A human-made acoustic measurement model that captures how a listener's head, torso, and pinnae filter sound arriving from different directions, built to persist through HRTF databases and spatial audio rendering pipelines.

payload.name: head-related-transfer-function
payload.scope: A human-made acoustic measurement model that captures how a listener's head, torso, and pinnae filter sound arriving from different directions, built to persist through HRTF databases and spatial audio rendering pipelines.

payload.body: Head-related transfer function is a human-made acoustic model that describes the frequency and phase response of a listener's anatomy as a function of source direction and distance. Parameters: (1) measurement geometry — azimuth, elevation, distance; (2) subject specificity — individual HRTFs measured via in-ear microphones, or generic HRTFs derived from KEMAR dummy head; (3) representation format — complex-valued impulse response or magnitude-phase spectra per direction. Persistence mechanism: stored as HRTF databases (e.g., MIT HRTF, CIPIC) and integrated into binaural rendering SDKs, game engines, and VR audio pipelines, where they are convolved with source audio to simulate spatial perception. [formal: hrtf | substrate: matter | horizon: a lifetime | explicit: yes | epoch: 0.01]

Removal test: remove head-related-transfer-function now, binaural rendering has no spatial filter to apply — the convolution stage ceases to produce direction-dependent spectral cues, so the technique stops operating as binaural rendering. The HRTF is the operational data the rendering algorithm requires; without it, the output collapses to plain stereo.
